name: Morikawa Mihono
source: A wealthy young lady who's betrothed to [url=/c83566]Nao[/url]. Nao's grandmother [url=/c28508]Ayame[/url] also makes her become a maid at the inn so she can learn what it takes to run the inn she will one day inherit. It's very difficult for her to act subservient.
